description: This course covers the basics of calculus-based college-level physics, including conservation of energy and momentum, kinematics and Newton’s laws, and the basics of electric and magnetic fields. As a comprehensive introductory course, this is a gateway course for the Physical Sciences major that is also suitable for non-majors wishing to build physical intuition or enter medical programs. Several labs will connect theory to the physics that describes reality
